#!/bin/bash
# The event by joint search (bench-report.md of feat/posting-edge-index, "El
# evento por búsqueda conjunta, y su puerta", pre-registered on 2026-11-28 by
# the user's order): what the searches of the pending vectors of a posting
# share at 1M and at 10M; the rule of the batch builder inside the simulator
# at 1M; the parts of the search of an insert at 1M; and the micro-benchmark
# of scoring the endpoints of a posting for m queries apart and together,
# with tables of 1M and of 10M doc ids. Over clones, removed at the end;
# nothing of an index is written. The binary is built before (lock/holds.test,
# the diagnostic branch with the simulator); nothing here builds. Timed: the
# micro-benchmark and the parts of the search are clocks.
set -u
S=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-abdel-Documents-Projects-hnsw-pq-wt-posting-edge-index/e94130d1-0af4-421d-89c2-936de2c15159/scratchpad
W=$S/sim2
B=$S/lock/holds.test
P=$S/diag/src/adapters/repos/db/vector/postingedge
D1=$HOME/Documents/datasets/dbpedia-openai-1000k-angular.bin
D10=$HOME/Documents/datasets/wikidpr-10m-e5-inplace.bin
mkdir -p $W/1m-joint $W/10m-joint $W/jointscore

printf 'the event by joint search, a simulation and a micro-benchmark (sim2/sim4.sh), timed, since %s for about forty minutes; taken down by the experiments session\n' "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')" > $S/timed-session.lock

hid_idle() { ioreg -c IOHIDSystem | awk '/HIDIdleTime/ {print int($NF/1000000000); exit}'; }
date "+== %H:%M:%S waiting for 900 s of idle (now $(hid_idle) s)"
while [ "$(hid_idle)" -lt 900 ]; do sleep 30; done
date "+== %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S idle for $(hid_idle) s"

# The micro-benchmark first, with the machine as quiet as it gets: the codes
# of the 100k index, tables of 1M and of 10M doc ids.
mkdir -p $W/jointscore/clone
cp -c -R $S/diag/i100k/index $W/jointscore/clone/index || exit 3
date "+== %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S the micro-benchmark (idle $(hid_idle) s)"
(cd $P && PE_DIR=$W/jointscore/clone/index PE_OUT=$W/jointscore/result.json \
  PE_JOINTSCORE="1000000:1962:2048,10000000:1962:2048" \
  $B -test.run '^TestDiagJointScore$' -test.v -test.timeout 0 > $W/jointscore/run.log 2>&1)
echo "jointscore exit $?"
find /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-abdel-Documents-Projects-hnsw-pq-wt-posting-edge-index/e94130d1-0af4-421d-89c2-936de2c15159/scratchpad/sim2/jointscore -type d -name index -prune -exec rm -rf {} +

# 1M.
mkdir -p /Volumes/v40bench/sim1m/clone
cp -c -R /Volumes/v40bench/sim1m/index /Volumes/v40bench/sim1m/clone/index || exit 3
find /Volumes/v40bench/sim1m/clone/index -type f -exec cat {} + > /dev/null
date "+== %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S 1M, the parts of the search of an insert (idle $(hid_idle) s)"
(cd $P && PE_DATASET=$D1 PE_DIR=/Volumes/v40bench/sim1m/clone/index PE_OUT=$W/1m-joint/search.json PE_NOMAINTENANCE=1 PE_SETTLE=15 \
  PE_THREADS=1 PE_N=8000 $B -test.run '^TestDiagSearch$' -test.v -test.timeout 0 > $W/1m-joint/search.log 2>&1)
echo "1M search exit $?"
date "+== %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S 1M, the joint searches (idle $(hid_idle) s)"
(cd $P && PE_DENSE=1 PE_DIR=/Volumes/v40bench/sim1m/clone/index PE_OUT=$W/1m-joint/joint.json PE_JOINT=8,16,32 PE_POSTINGS=200 \
  $B -test.run '^TestSimJoint$' -test.v -test.timeout 0 > $W/1m-joint/joint.log 2>&1)
echo "1M joint exit $?"
date "+== %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S 1M, the rule of the batch builder (idle $(hid_idle) s)"
(cd $P && PE_DENSE=1 PE_DATASET=$D1 PE_DIR=/Volumes/v40bench/sim1m/clone/index PE_OUT=$W/1m-joint/lote.json PE_QUERIES=1000 \
  PE_SIM="base,lote:64,lote:128,lote:256" $B -test.run '^TestSimTwoStep$' -test.v -test.timeout 0 > $W/1m-joint/lote.log 2>&1)
echo "1M lote exit $?"
find /Volumes/v40bench/sim1m/clone -type d -name index -prune -exec rm -rf {} +

# 10M.
mkdir -p /Volumes/v40bench/grow10m/clones/sim4
cp -c -R /Volumes/v40bench/grow10m/index /Volumes/v40bench/grow10m/clones/sim4/index || exit 3
find /Volumes/v40bench/grow10m/clones/sim4/index -type f -exec cat {} + > /dev/null
date "+== %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S 10M, the joint searches (idle $(hid_idle) s)"
(cd $P && PE_DIR=/Volumes/v40bench/grow10m/clones/sim4/index PE_OUT=$W/10m-joint/joint.json PE_JOINT=8,16,32 PE_POSTINGS=200 \
  $B -test.run '^TestSimJoint$' -test.v -test.timeout 0 > $W/10m-joint/joint.log 2>&1)
echo "10M joint exit $?"
find /Volumes/v40bench/grow10m/clones/sim4 -type d -name index -prune -exec rm -rf {} +

date "+== %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S done (idle $(hid_idle) s)" | tee $W/end-joint.txt
rm -f /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-abdel-Documents-Projects-hnsw-pq-wt-posting-edge-index/e94130d1-0af4-421d-89c2-936de2c15159/scratchpad/timed-session.lock
